name: Snake Plant
hook: Killed every plant you've owned? Start with this one.

steps.title: Let the soil dry fully
steps.tip: Water only when the soil is dry. A whole plant leaning over can be a sign of root rot.

steps.title: Any light works
steps.tip: It grows fastest in bright, indirect light, but tolerates dim hallways and north windows.

steps.title: Use cactus mix
steps.tip: A gritty, fast-draining cactus or succulent mix in a pot with a drainage hole is a must.

steps.title: Keep it warm
steps.tip: Keep it away from cold drafts and radiators, and always above 10°C.

steps.title: Repot when the pot bulges
steps.tip: It likes a snug pot, so only go slightly bigger when roots fill the pot or bend it out of shape.

outro: Neglect is the secret. Forget it for weeks and it thrives.
